## Terms

### Atlas CLI

- **Atlas CLI** · self — Atlas CLI manages MongoDB Atlas from the terminal. Developers can script resource provisioning and keep those scripts in version control. (high confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongodb-atlas-cli
